newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh Bank allows money changers to operate.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh Bank allows money changers to operate.

text.p: Bangladesh Bank, the central bank, has allowed 16 companies to operate as money changers, central bank officials said on Tuesday.
They said the money changers were given licences to buy and sell foreign exchange to Bangladeshi and overseas travellers.
The step has been taken under a policy of liberalising the government's foreign exchange policy, they said. Bangladesh has already made its currency, the taka, convertible on current (trade) account.
Officials with commercial banks hailed the central bank move, saying it would create an atmosphere of competitiveness in the trade.
"This is a good step. It's a good move in the right direction. Although it may take some of our business it will bring in competition," said one official with a foreign bank.
The officials said nearly $1 million is traded daily to meet the requirement of travellers.
